name.value: Myra Canyon Bicycle Rental and Tours Inc.

description.value: Myra Canyon Bicycle Rental and Tours Inc. is the first and only on-site bike rental company at the Myra Station trailhead of the Kettle Valley Railway's Myra Canyon section, roughly 40 minutes from downtown Kelowna. Cyclists can explore 18 historic wooden trestles and two tunnels on a flat, 12 km (one-way) trail that draws over 75,000 visitors a year. The family-operated business, recognized as a Biosphere Committed Entity for Tourism Sustainability, offers comfort bikes, e-bikes, guided half-day tours, a full-day self-guided Kelowna-to-Penticton option, and adaptive cycling coordination through People in Motion.

address.value: Myra Station Parking, Kelowna, BC, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at myracanyonrental.com is comprehensive and active for the 2026 season, providing the primary evidence base. The business name on the website ('Myra Canyon Bicycle Rental and Tours Inc.') differs from the OSM record ('Myra Canyon Bike Rental'), so the website name is used and the discrepancy flagged in concerns. Key evidence: the website explicitly states 'there is no water at the parking lot or on the trail,' which establishes a clear negative for water refill and free water; the FAQ and homepage both confirm a concession stand with snacks on site; no mention of washrooms, bike racks, or other infrastructure amenities was found in the website content.
concerns: OSM name 'Myra Canyon Bike Rental' differs from the website name 'Myra Canyon Bicycle Rental and Tours Inc.' — website name used as it is more complete and current.
No civic address or postal code available; OSM has no address and the website gives only 'Myra Station Parking, Kelowna, B.C. Canada' as the location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, cycling-specific business operating directly at one of BC's most-visited cycling destinations; clearly valuable to any touring or recreational cyclist in the Kelowna area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Located within Myra-Bellevue Provincial Park at the Myra Station parking lot, accessed via McCulloch Road and Myra Forest Service Road. Contact email from website: [email protected]. Business holds Biosphere Committed Entity recognition for tourism sustainability.

Water bottle refill.detail: Website states: 'please remember to bring water with you as there is no water at the parking lot or on the trail.'

Café or food on site.detail: FAQ confirms 'a small concession stand at the Myra Station parking lot with water, Clif bars, and souvenirs'; homepage also mentions 'bottled water and snacks' and 'ponchos for those rainy days.'

Water without admission.detail: Website explicitly states 'there is no water at the parking lot or on the trail'; concession sells bottled water for purchase only

wow_evidence: The on-site rental and tour operator at Myra Station trailhead; enables the trestle ride for the unequipped (KW-PRIVATE is rentals false positive).
blurb: Bike rentals and tours at the Myra Station trailhead of the trestle canyon.
